verdict.rationale: Highnote clearly takes on program-management work: its in-house compliance and operations teams handle KYC/KYB, transaction monitoring, reconciliation and settlement, and a disputes team handles chargebacks. It also markets fast card program launch and a production-like test environment you can use "before you talk to anyone." But the pack never mentions BIN or sponsor-bank arrangements. Network membership is only implied by a generic "direct network integration" line, and no signup-to-live-card timeline is documented. Missing for 10: explicit BIN/sponsor-bank sponsorship evidence, clear network-membership responsibility, documented time from signup to first live card, independent corroboration.
